h1:
Sa Kaeo Mookata
10 Popular Spots for a Group Dinner
intro: In Sa Kaeo, the dinner friends meet up for most often is mookata — a grill in the middle of the table, jaew dipping sauce, cold beer, and a long catch-up. We've picked the places locals actually eat at, across Sa Kaeo town, Aranyaprathet and Watthana Nakhon, with the approximate price per head, opening hours, and which spots work best when you're coming as a group.

blocks.html: Most mookata in Sa Kaeo is all-you-can-eat buffet, with per-head prices starting at around 120 THB and going up to about 250 THB at places with plenty of imported meat and seafood. Restaurants open from late afternoon into the night, roughly 3–4 PM until almost midnight — good for meeting friends after work or a family get-together on a day off. We've split the places by area to keep it clear, because Sa Kaeo is a province where the town and Aranyaprathet sit in opposite corners, about an hour's drive apart.

blocks.title: Check the price before you order
blocks.html: The per-head prices we list are approximate ranges from reviews and the restaurants' pages. Real prices shift with promotions and what you pick (imported beef, prawns and squid are often charged extra). It's worth calling to check or looking at the restaurant's page on the day you go, especially on long weekends when many places book out fast.
If you're staying or working in Sa Kaeo town, the Suwannason Road area is the easiest spot to reach for grilled food, with both Thai-style mookata and Korean-style BBQ depending on your mood.

items.name: Sojeng Korean BBQ, Sa Kaeo Branch
items.blurb: A Korean-style grill that Sa Kaeo locals bring up often — fragrant marinated meat, several dipping sauces, and a big, table-heavy room that suits a large group well. It's on Suwannason Road and easy to get to.

items.name: Wandee Mookata
items.blurb: An all-you-can-eat buffet that leans on variety, with over a hundred sides and fresh items to choose from — good value if you eat a lot. The vibe is laid-back, and it's a place town families meet up at regularly.

items.name: Khun Ammy Mookata, Branch 2
items.blurb: The Sa Kaeo town branch of a restaurant that first made its name in Aranyaprathet. It does both mookata and spicy yam salads, opens evening till late, and suits meeting friends after work for a long, relaxed sit.
items.meta: Sa Kaeo town · Open ~3 PM–11:30 PM

items.name: Aroi Ta To Mookata, Branch 1
items.blurb: A budget mookata spot in town that's all about value and getting full — a good pick for an easy dinner that's kind to your wallet. Plenty of students and families go.

blocks.html: Aranyaprathet is a busy border town, so its mookata restaurants compete hard — prices are good and there are more options than you'd expect, with many being full-on buffets. It's handy if you've come to visit Rong Kluea Market and need somewhere for dinner.

items.name: Khun Ammy Mookata, Branch 1
items.blurb: The original Aranyaprathet branch that made the brand a name. Mookata paired with bold, spicy yam salads, open from evening until midnight — a meet-up spot for locals who finish work late.

items.name: Nong Da Mookata
items.blurb: A single-price buffet that Aranyaprathet locals go to regularly, with fresh items topped up all evening. Open 4 PM to 11 PM — good for a weekday group dinner with no fussing over the price per plate.

items.name: Phet Wang Thong Buffet
items.blurb: A grill buffet that lays out a lot, with more beef and seafood to choose from for a price a touch above the usual spots — good if you want to eat your money's worth and go all in.

items.name: Go Grill Buffet BBQ
items.blurb: A Korean-style buffet grill in Aranyaprathet that focuses on marinated meat and a nicely decorated room — good for a younger group that wants both the food and a spot for photos.

blocks.html: Watthana Nakhon district sits between Sa Kaeo town and Aranyaprathet, and locals rate its mookata spots for value and good flavour. If you're driving this stretch in the evening, it's worth a stop.

items.name: Piti Mookata & Shabu, Watthana Nakhon
items.blurb: A restaurant praised in Wongnai reviews for fresh ingredients and good value, with both mookata and shabu under one roof — good for a group that wants grilled and boiled without having to choose.

items.name: Khun Chompoo Mookata, Branch 1 Watthana Nakhon
items.blurb: A buffet in Watthana Nakhon open daily from 3 PM to 11 PM, with lots of tables and easy parking — good for a big group or a family gathering. It's at 999 Moo 10, Watthana Nakhon subdistrict.

blocks.html: Mookata and a group dinner already go well together, but to keep the meal smooth there's a little to sort out beforehand — especially if there are a lot of you or you're going on a day off.

items: Call to book a table if there are more than 6 of you — popular spots in town and Aranyaprathet fill up fast on Friday and Saturday, so booking half a day ahead is the safer bet.
Go before 6 PM — early evening is the busiest. If you don't want to wait for a grill, get there early evening for a good table.
Check whether ice and drinking water are included — some places charge separately, some include them in the buffet price. Ask first to avoid confusion.
Imported beef, prawns and squid are often charged extra — on a tight budget, pick a single-price place that includes everything and it's easier to control.
Easy to split per head — a single-price buffet makes sharing the bill across a group simple, with no adding up plate by plate.

blocks.title: On the border, if you're planning to continue
blocks.html: If you eat mookata in Aranyaprathet and are thinking of crossing to Poipet or carrying on to Siem Reap, always check the border situation and your crossing documents with the Aranyaprathet–Khlong Luk checkpoint before you actually travel. Checkpoint hours and conditions can change — don't rely on old information.

faq.q: Which Sa Kaeo mookata is the best value for a group?
faq.a: If you want value and an easy split, go for a single-price buffet like Nong Da Mookata (Aranyaprathet, around 199 THB) or Wandee Mookata (Sa Kaeo town), which have big menus and a clear per-head price, so sharing the bill is simple.

faq.q: Where in Sa Kaeo town are the mookata restaurants?
faq.a: The Suwannason Road area is the main spot, with Sojeng Korean BBQ, Khun Ammy Branch 2 and Wandee Mookata. They're easy to reach from town and have parking.

faq.q: What time do Sa Kaeo mookata restaurants open?
faq.a: Most open from late afternoon into the night, roughly 3–4 PM until 11 PM or midnight. Some, like Khun Ammy, stay open to around midnight — good for a dinner meet-up after work.

faq.q: Roughly how much is it per head?
faq.a: A regular buffet starts at around 120–199 THB per head, while Korean BBQ or loaded buffets with imported meat and seafood move up to 229–250 THB. Real prices shift with promotions and what you pick.

faq.q: Where's good for mookata if I'm visiting Aranyaprathet?
faq.a: Khun Ammy Branch 1 and Nong Da Mookata are the spots Aranyaprathet locals go to regularly — good value and open late. For Korean BBQ, try Go Grill; and big eaters like Phet Wang Thong for laying out plenty.
